label: FP
reason: All 3 alerts are False Positives. Alert 1 (XSS): Resolved sink value is encodeForHTML(output) - data is properly HTML-encoded before response output. Alert 2 (Stack Trace): Standard Java servlet behavior exposing stack traces to client is not considered a vulnerability in this context. Alert 3 (Weak Crypto): Algorithm is configured via properties file with fallback, not directly from user input - resolved sink value is a property-based configuration string, not attacker-controlled.

evidence.note: XSS sink uses encodeForHTML() which properly encodes output before writing to response
Stack trace exposure via e.printStackTrace() - standard Java behavior, not a vulnerability
Crypto algorithm from properties file with fallback, not user-controlled
